content.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.0.label: 这里是什么地方？
content.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.1.label: 读那块标签。
content.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.2.label: 略过标签。
content.dlg.curator.curator-root.text: 目录翻在第一页。“你来早了，”她说。“这里没有一件是完成的，而这正是它的用处。”
content.dlg.curator.curator-what.opt.0.label: 退回。
content.dlg.curator.curator-what.text: “一座厅。引擎能被要求建造的每一样东西各一件——这样当引擎学会一个新词时，早已有一只展柜在等它。”
content.dlg.factor.factor-root.opt.0.label: 只是看看。
content.dlg.factor.factor-root.text: “柜台开着。上面的每样都标了价，没有一样是我的。”
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-read.opt.0.label: 它说这厅是为谁而设。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-read.opt.0.tooltip: 把标签一字不差地背给没读过它的典礼官听。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-read.text: “你在讲台前停了。那就把它说的话，当着点兵的面说一遍。”
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.opt.0.label: 那就让开。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.text: “列队，或者让开。点兵不等读书人。”
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-skipped.opt.0.label: 我们没停下来读。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-skipped.opt.0.toolti: 向同样没读过它的典礼官承认没人读过。
content.dlg.marshal.marshal-skipped.text: “你走过去了。那就说说你以为这厅是做什么的，快些。”
content.dlg.warden.warden-root.opt.0.label: 明白了。
content.dlg.warden.warden-root.text: “墙才是展品，”他说。“不是墙后面的东西。”
content.fx.far-hall.done.1.respawn.0.narrate: 你在讲台旁醒来，阅读从这里开始。
content.fx.far-hall.oc.clear-the-muster.11.seale: 正门已经落下，从这一侧抬不起来。
content.fx.far-hall.oc.clear-the-muster.15.narra: 队列过去之前，别踏进亮处。
content.fx.shop.counter.0.0.narrate: 经纪把钥匙翻过来看了一眼，又放了回去。四枚代币，他说。
content.fx.trap.plate.0.narrate: 石板下有一块压板咔哒作响。
content.fx.trig.reach-the-vantage.0.narrate: 从这里望去，整座厅是一幅画。
content.fx.trig.read-the-label.0.narrate: 展柜下的标签写着：每一个表面，各写一次。
content.fx.trig.skip-the-label.0.narrate: 守望者不回应一记打击。
content.lethal.east-pit.message: 北墙边的空气与你不合。
content.lethal.west-pit.message: 西角的地面并不是地面。

source.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.0.label: What is this place?
source.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.1.label: Read the label.
source.dlg.curator.curator-root.opt.2.label: Skip the label.
source.dlg.curator.curator-root.text: The catalogue is open at the first page. "You are early," she says. "Nothing here is finished, which is the point of it."
source.dlg.curator.curator-what.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.curator.curator-what.text: "One hall. One of everything the engine can be told to build, so that when the engine learns a new word, there is already a case waiting for it."
source.dlg.factor.factor-root.opt.0.label: Just looking.
source.dlg.factor.factor-root.text: "Counter's open. Everything on it is priced and nothing on it is mine."
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-read.opt.0.label: It said who the hall is for.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-read.opt.0.tooltip: Repeat the label, word for word, to a Marshal who did not read it.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-read.text: "You stopped at the lectern. Say what it said, and say it in front of the muster."
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.opt.0.label: Stand aside, then.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-root.text: "Form up or stand aside. The muster does not wait on readers."
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-skipped.opt.0.label: We did not stop to read.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-skipped.opt.0.toolti: Admit to a Marshal who did not read it either that nobody read it.
source.dlg.marshal.marshal-skipped.text: "You walked past it. So say what you think the hall is for, and be quick."
source.dlg.warden.warden-root.opt.0.label: Understood.
source.dlg.warden.warden-root.text: "The wall is the exhibit," he says. "Not what is behind it."
source.fx.death.1.narrate: The hall puts you back at the hearth.
You come to at the hearth.
You come to at the hearth.
source.fx.far-hall.done.1.respawn.0.narrate: You come back at the lectern, where the reading started.
source.fx.far-hall.oc.clear-the-muster.11.seale: The main gate has come back down and will not lift from this side.
source.fx.far-hall.oc.clear-the-muster.15.narra: Keep out of the light until the march has passed.
source.fx.near-hall.done.1.rest.0.narrate: The hearth takes the chill off.
source.fx.near-hall.oc.reach-the-counter.0.arri: "Read the far side too," she says.
source.fx.sc.side-door.0.narrate: The side door is barred no longer.
source.fx.shop.counter.0.0.narrate: The Factor turns the key over once and puts it back. Four tokens, he says.
source.fx.trap.chest.0.narrate: The chest was not the exhibit.
source.fx.trap.plate.0.narrate: A plate clicks under the flagstone.
source.fx.trig.reach-the-vantage.0.narrate: From here the whole hall is one picture.
source.fx.trig.read-the-label.0.narrate: The label under the case reads: every surface, written once.
source.fx.trig.shortcut-door-barred.0.narrate: The side door is barred from the other side.
source.fx.trig.skip-the-label.0.narrate: The Warden does not answer a blow.
source.fx.trig.west-bay.0.narrate: Something shifts up in the rafters.
